palette.bronze_note: AGED bronze, dull - the board renders bright; desaturate/value-down in production, never gold

rules: Panels: dark indigo, thin double bronze border line, subtle plain-weave texture at low opacity
Buttons: square/circle, bronze rim, flat indigo fill; no glow, no gradients beyond 8% value shift
Health/resource: segmented bronze-and-indigo strip (segments = readability, not ornament)
Icons: plain geometric placeholders (diamond/circle/square) until gameplay defines meanings - NO invented symbols or pseudo-script
Spiral: single fictional accent mark only (from Adanna pendant fiction); never used as a cultural symbol or pattern repeat
Typography: none specified here - no letterforms invented; TD/UX to select a licensed legible font later
prohibited: nsibidi or any real script/signs as decoration
